cases.prompt: Read input.json. For each invoice calculate balanceCents = billedCents minus all settled payments minus all approved credits; ignore pending payments and rejected credits. Negative balances must remain negative. Output artifacts/result.json as {"invoices":[{"id":string,"balanceCents":integer}],"totalBalanceCents":integer}. Sort invoices by id ascending. Include every invoice and no extra fields. Do not change input.json.

Read input.json. Process orders by ascending priority number, breaking ties by id ascending. Allocate each order only if remaining stock for its sku covers its entire quantity; otherwise allocate zero and leave stock unchanged. Output artifacts/result.json as {"orders":[{"id":string,"allocated":integer}],"remaining":{sku:integer}}. Orders must appear in processing order. Include all SKUs in remaining, no extra fields, and preserve input.json.

Read input.json. Route tickets by these rules in precedence order: security=true routes to security; otherwise tier=enterprise and ageHours>=24 routes to priority; otherwise topic=billing routes to billing; otherwise routes to general. Output artifacts/result.json as {"tickets":[{"id":string,"queue":string}],"counts":{"security":integer,"priority":integer,"billing":integer,"general":integer}}. Sort tickets by id ascending, include zero counts, no extra fields, and preserve input.json.
